summary: Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a new $50M share repurchase program approved by the board on June 19, 2026, replacing a prior program. Repurchases may occur on the open market or via Rule 10b5-1 plans, funded from available cash with no set expiry. No specific price, premium, dates, or advisor are given. The program is discretionary and carries no obligation. The market should watch future buyback pace and potential for program activation vs. other capital uses; risk-arb is not applicable here.
